name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter_event_handler; descriptor=09=dispatch idx 0x09 of the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91, a meaningful domain ID, plus ch3 chapter tag + char_cond category). The 09 suffix is the dispatch-table index (not a Ghidra address residue: the function address is 0x344c2). Consistent with the whole chevt1.c _NN__chMM_category naming scheme across ~40 sibling handlers.
purpose: Chapter 3 turn-3 char-conditional cutscene beat (per-event handler table idx 0x09): if the protected ally swordsman 鐵諾 (runtime char #6) is still alive, reload portrait set 2, pan the camera from world (3,0) to (3,0x11) with ~800ms/~200ms holds, and show dialog page 4.
logic_summary: Single guard: if fd2_check_char_is_dead(6) == 0 (runtime char #6 = ch3 ally 鐵諾 alive, bFlags bit0 clear) then run the cutscene: fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2) -> fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(3,0) -> fd2_delay_ms(800) -> fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(3,0x11) -> fd2_delay_ms(200) -> fd2_display_dialog_scene(text, page 4, fixed geometry 0xA0000/0x140/0xCD/0x4C/0x4A/0x13/1). If char #6 is dead the whole body is skipped. No RNG, no numeric computation; the only branch is the alive gate, and no CALL-return value is used except the dead-bit zero test. event_arg is unread.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform dispatch argument from the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (all slots are 1-arg cdecl). This handler never reads it (cast to void).
params.reason: Accurately describes the unread dispatch-table event argument; no address residue, not a generic param_N placeholder.

comment_original_issue: The original src comment and Ghidra plate attributed runtime char #6 to '沃斯', but that name does not appear in the KB 32-character roster and contradicts the chapter-3 walkthrough. Per fd2-knowledge: ch3 turn-3 event = enemy leader + reinforcements appear; the party protects the ally swordsman 鐵諾, who 'joins if not dead'. The paired fd2_chapter_03_end (chend1.c) gates on the same fd2_check_char_is_dead(6) and recruits char #2 = 劍士鐵諾 when alive (portrait 02h = 鐵諾; code-hack note '22 = 劍聖鐵諾'). So runtime char #6 is the in-battle representation of 鐵諾 (recruited as permanent party char #2 if he survives), NOT 沃斯.

issues.title: char_id 6 mis-attributed to 沃斯 (corrected to 鐵諾)
issues.description: Both the src comment block and the Ghidra plate named runtime char #6 as '沃斯', an unverified name absent from the KB 32-char roster. Cross-checking fd2-knowledge (chapter 3 events/recruitment, portraits 02h, code_hacks '22 = 劍聖鐵諾') and the sibling fd2_chapter_03_end handler (chend1.c, same fd2_check_char_is_dead(6) gate -> recruits char #2 劍士鐵諾) establishes char #6 as the in-battle ally swordsman 鐵諾. Fixed in this refine (src comment + plate). This is a comment/attribution correction only; no game logic changed (the code uses literal index 6, which is correct).
issues.evidence: KB chapter 3: '加入：劍士鐵諾若未死時加入' and '索爾及亞雷斯前去幫助鐵諾'; KB portraits 02h=鐵諾, code_hacks '22 = 劍聖鐵諾'; chend1.c fd2_chapter_03_end @0x230F2 gates on fd2_check_char_is_dead(6)==0 then fd2_init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(2) recruiting 劍士鐵諾; '沃斯' has zero matches in the KB (query.py grep).
